```yaml
name: Build Linux No-Container Wheels

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      platform:
        required: true
        type: string
      python-version:
        required: true
        type: string
      cuda-version:
        required: true
        type: string
      build-matrix:
        required: true
        type: string
      wheel-name:
        required: true
        type: string

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ${{ inputs.platform }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ inputs.python-version }}

      - name: Setup CUDA
        uses: ethanhs/setup-cuda@v1.0.0
        with:
          cuda-version: ${{ inputs.cuda-version }}
          toolkit-path: /usr/local/cuda

      - name: Install build dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install setuptools wheel scikit-build-core[pyproject]
          pip install ninja

      - name: Setup uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v5
        with:
          enable-cache: true
          cache-dependency-glob: "pyproject.toml"

      - name: Build wheels
        id: build_wheels
        run: |
          # Build the package using uv
          uv build --wheel --no-sources --python-preference only-managed
          
          # Find the built wheel
          WHEEL_PATH=$(find . -name "*.whl" | head -n 1)
          echo "wheel_path=$WHEEL_PATH" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Upload wheel
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: ${{ inputs.wheel-name }}
          path: ${{ steps.build_wheels.outputs.wheel_path }}
          if-no-files-found: error

      - name: Cleanup
        if: always()
        run: |
          # Remove flash-attention source
          rm -rf flash_attn*
          
          # Remove virtual environment
          rm -rf .venv
          
          # Remove pip cache
          rm -rf ~/.cache/pip
          
          # Remove uv cache
          rm -rf ~/.cache/uv
          
          # Remove CUDA cache if exists
          rm -rf /tmp/cuda*
          
          # Clean up build artifacts
          rm -rf build/
          rm -rf dist/
          find . -name "*.egg-info" -type d -exec rm -rf {} +
```
